mapper.select: SELECT store_id,merchant_id,name,status,version,opening_subject_type AS subject_type,opening_category AS category, opening_review_ref AS review_reference,opened_by,opened_at,opening_category_code AS category_code FROM store_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{id} AND opening_subject_type IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE store_record SET name=#{input.name}, opening_subject_type=#{input.subjectType}, opening_category=#{category}, opening_category_code=#{input.categoryCode}, version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{id} AND status='PENDING_OPEN' AND version=#{input.expectedVersion}
mapper.sql: FROM store_opening_category child JOIN store_opening_category parent ON parent.category_code=child.parent_code WHERE parent.parent_code IS NULL AND parent.enabled AND child.enabled
mapper.select:
SELECT child.category_code AS code, CONCAT(parent.name,' / ',child.name) AS label
ORDER BY parent.sort_order, parent.category_code, child.sort_order, child.category_code

SELECT CONCAT(parent.name,' / ',child.name)
AND child.category_code=#{code} FOR SHARE
mapper.update: UPDATE store_record SET status='ACTIVE', opening_review_ref=#{input.reviewReference}, opened_by=#{actor}, opened_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{id} AND status='PENDING_OPEN' AND version=#{input.expectedVersion}
